title: Suffix Boxes
rule: A suffix is an ending added to a base word, like ed, ing, or ly. Draw a box around the whole suffix.
trickText: Find the base word first. Then look at the ending that was added to it. Box only the ending. Not every word that ends in the same letters has a suffix.
say: Today's case: suffixes. A suffix is an ending added to a base word. First find the base word. Then put a box around the ending that was added.

example.answer: j u m p e# d#
example.say: Look at jumped. The base word is jump. The ending e d was added. So I put a box around e d.

activities.instruction: Find the base word. Then box the suffix.

items.answer: j u m p e# d#
h e l p e# d#
c a m p i# n# g#
h a n d i# n# g#
